text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't touch the tests, only the code in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`. This fixed both `test_year_is_int` and `test_age`.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, as the comment and tests say.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee was `days_late + DAILY_FEE` and is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many. It now slices `[-n:]`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing the third book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The title and count come from the docstring and tests. The author, year and copies are my own choice, since nothing specifies them.
